patch_description: Add a final deterministic constrained optimization phase using the exact packing formulation: maximize a common squared separation lower bound `r` subject to every pairwise squared distance lying in `[r, 1]`. The existing stochastic/contact-graph search is retained for global basin discovery, while SLSQP receives its best result as a high-quality feasible warm start. Anchoring one point at the origin removes translational degeneracy, and scaling the incumbent diameter to one makes the constraint system directly match the evaluator objective. Analytic constraint Jacobians make this polishing phase substantially more reliable and faster than finite-difference constrained optimization.
